title: Uniform extended noise mass
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a real parameter $\rho$, and points $x,y\in\Omega$, define their noise mass to be $\bigl(1+(|\Omega|-1)\rho\bigr)/|\Omega|$ when $y=x$, and $(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$ when $y\ne x$.
